design.decision: Count [♠] winners into the bid and stretch the contract, since each [♠] win is worth more the higher your team bids.
design.opponent: Shown on the first [♠] win; opponents try to set high contracts by leading [♠] to pull trumps together.
design.rationale: It meets the bid-tension target at rare and replaces the weak flat seed-spade-mult shape with one that scales with the contract (cb-contract-mult is the strongest measured common shape). The ♠-win filter keeps it a Spades piece, not a generic one.
design.draftText: +1 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract when your team wins a trick with [♠]

critic.concerns: Functionally overlaps ua-trump-contract-mult, since most [♠] wins are ruffs, and differs from ua-ace-win-contract only in the filter; long sentence.
